data: Which of the four lines in the graph on the right is highest?

The caption indicates that there are two graphs labeled (a) Full dataset and (b) 10% of the dataset. The question asks which line among the four lines in the graph is the highest. From the caption, we can see that each graph has four lines representing different training conditions: No pre-training, No unfreezing, Unfreeze word layers, and Unfreeze all layers. 

In both graphs, the purple line (Unfreeze word layers) appears to be consistently higher than the other three lines across the entire range of training time. Therefore, the purple line is the highest among the four lines in the graph.
